hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; { echo "# Stanje projekta (SessionStart hook)"; echo; echo "## Aktivni task — tasks/CURRENT.md"; cat tasks/CURRENT.md 2>/dev/null || echo "(nema aktivnog taska — pokreni /task load <NN>)"; echo; echo "## Git"; git status --short --branch 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo; git log --oneline -3 2>/dev/null; } | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:.}}'
